'''Imperial Headquarters, Southern Sector''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[IM-455 modular garrison|garrison]] under construction on the outskirts of [[Zila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garos IV]]. It was assaulted by elements of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garosian underground]].
